calculator.title: Indicative China import calculator
calculator.supporting: Transport, customs duty, VAT and delivery costs to Poland. The result is indicative and does not constitute a commercial offer.

fields.intro: Hover over or click (?) next to a field if you are unsure what to enter.

fieldHelp.goods: Enter the amount from the pro forma invoice or supplier offer. For EXW and FOB this is the goods value only, excluding transport and customs duty.
fieldHelp.goodsCif: Enter the CIF invoice amount, where sea freight to the destination port is already included. Do not add international freight separately.
fieldHelp.currency: Currency of the Chinese supplier's invoice, most commonly USD or EUR.
fieldHelp.mode: Choose the shipping method. A full 20/40 ft container suits larger regular shipments; LCL is for smaller shared-container cargo; air is faster but more expensive.
fieldHelp.cbm: Volume of the packed goods in cubic metres. Find it on the packing list or calculate length × width × height in metres.
fieldHelp.kg: Gross weight of the shipment including packaging and pallets, in kilograms. Look for 'gross weight' on the packing list.
fieldHelp.incoterm: Delivery terms shown on the pro forma invoice. EXW = pickup at the factory in China; FOB = delivered to the Chinese port; CIF = sea freight to the destination port is included.
fieldHelp.cnCodes: Number of different product types in the shipment. One product → enter 1; mixed products → number of different customs codes.
fieldHelp.duty: Import customs duty depends on the product. If you do not know the rate, select 'I don't know' to see 0%, 5% and 10% scenarios.
fieldHelp.customDuty: Enter the duty rate from TARIC or provided by your customs broker, e.g. 3.5%.
fieldHelp.usdPln: USD to PLN exchange rate. It is fetched automatically from NBP Table A by default and can be changed manually.
fieldHelp.eurPln: EUR to PLN exchange rate. It is fetched automatically from NBP Table A by default and can be changed manually.
fieldHelp.insurance: Cargo insurance for transport — 0.5% of goods value, minimum USD 50. It is usually worth including.
fieldHelp.insuranceCif: With CIF, insurance is already included in the goods price and should not be added again.

results.title: Result
results.transportCifNote: International freight included in CIF value
results.footerDisclaimer: VAT 23%. Customs duty depends on the CN/TARIC code. Broker clearance: PLN 250 + PLN 20 per additional CN code. Transport range: ±15%. VAT is shown separately because it may be deductible for an active VAT taxpayer.

disclaimers.form: Rates are examples and require regular updates. The calculator does not automatically handle dangerous goods, batteries, chemicals, food, excise duties or anti-dumping duties.
disclaimers.freight: An exact freight quote requires weight, volume, pickup address and delivery location.
disclaimers.general: The result is indicative and does not constitute a commercial offer or tax advice.
